paper_id: Bridging Context Gaps_ Leveraging Coreference Resolution for Long Contextual Understanding
title: Bridging Context Gaps: Leveraging Coreference Resolution for Long Contextual Understanding
motivation: LLMs struggle to accurately identify key passages from the middle of long contexts and generate effective responses when overwhelmed by excessive information
problem_framing: Long texts with numerous pronouns, modifiers, and varying noun phrases cause comprehension challenges for LLMs, especially with ambiguous sentences
key_insight: Resolving coreferences and replacing vague mentions with representative mentions systematically partitions context into easier-to-handle segments for LLMs
method_signature: LQCA: coreference resolution on sub-documents + mentions distance computation + representative mention definition + QA with mention replacement
evaluation_criteria: Rouge-L for summarization, Accuracy for QA, F1 for knowledge extraction across 9 datasets on 5 different LLMs
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Coreference resolution struggles with ambiguous references or high complexity contexts, leading to inaccurate mention replacements; effectiveness may diminish for shorter contexts
evidence_for_taste: the coreference resolution method using the LLM shows significant shortcomings in answering questions
the model is currently unable to effectively handle specific downstream tasks
excessively high threshold may degrade coreference resolution performance
RQCA-with RAG method helps smaller models extract relevant information
thinking_moves: 识别到LLM在长上下文中容易混淆指代，先解决coreference再喂给LLM
把长文档切分成sub-documents来规避模型token限制，再用聚类合并结果
使用图的最长路径算法来计算跨文档mentions的距离和关联
